description: This Java class, CalendarRepositoryWrapper, provides a wrapper around the CalendarRepository interface, adding exception handling for not found cases, and methods for saving and deleting Calendar entities.

classes.name: CalendarRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for CalendarRepository that provides methods with built-in not found exception handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a Calendar by ID, throws CalendarNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Calendar entity to the repository.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Calendar entity from the repository.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes the Calendar entity to the database.
